# möbius for macOS 0.17.5

Questions and approvals wait in a horizontally paged tail deck, then retain their outcomes in the original transcript turn. Question answers no longer appear as duplicate user messages. Earlier history uses the shared row animations.

Questions, approvals and generated interfaces share a compact title header with the glyph at the top right. Light cards have a distinct neutral grey surface. Bundles gateway **0.17.5**; protocol **101** is unchanged.
